# hyperfluid_service_account_access (Resource)

The roles, grants and attributes of a service account created in the console or with `hfctl`. Destroying it clears the lists it manages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The account itself is created in the console or with hfctl.
data "hyperfluid_service_account" "etl" {
  client_id = "etl"
}

resource "hyperfluid_service_account_access" "etl" {
  service_account_id = data.hyperfluid_service_account.etl.id
  roles              = [{ role_id = hyperfluid_role.auditor.id }]
  grants             = [{ permission = "bucket:read_objects", scope_path = "default/exports" }]
  attributes         = ["region::eu"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account_id` (String) Service account id (its `id`, not its `client_id`).

### Optional

- `attributes` (Set of String) Row-level-security attributes, `namespace::value`. Left out, it is not managed; once set, it is authoritative and removing it clears it.
- `grants` (Attributes Set) Permissions granted directly to this principal. Left out, it is not managed; once set, it is authoritative and removing it clears it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `roles` (Attributes Set) Roles bound to this principal. Left out, it is not managed; once set, it is authoritative and removing it clears it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The service_account_id.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Required:

- `permission` (String) Permission key, e.g. `secret:read`.

Optional:

- `effect` (String) `allow` (default) or `deny`.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Id of the resource an exact `scope_path` names, e.g. `hyperfluid_secret.x.id`.
- `scope_path` (String) Resource path, exact or a wildcard such as `prod/*`. Omit for organization-wide.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role id.

Optional:

- `resource_type` (String) Limits the role to its permissions on this resource type; needs an exact `scope_path`.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Id of the resource an exact `scope_path` names, e.g. `hyperfluid_secret.x.id`.
- `scope_path` (String) Resource path, exact or a wildcard such as `prod/*`. Omit for organization-wide.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is the service account id. No list is managed until the configuration sets it.
terraform import hyperfluid_service_account_access.etl 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
